class.name: FileSystemDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that stores each record as one [DictionaryRecord] file.
class.description: A record lives at [code]<root>/<table>/<id>.<ext>[/code]. The root folds [member app_id] and the open slot into [member base_dir], so two saves of one game never meet. [codeblock lang=text] base_dir └── app_id └── slot └── table └── id.res [/codeblock] Every read and write goes straight to disk through [ResourceLoader] and [ResourceSaver]. There is no cache, so [member NetwDatabase.warm_policy] is ignored and a write is durable the moment it returns. [codeblock] var db := NetwDatabase.new() var fs := FileSystemDatabase.new() fs.base_dir = "user://saves" fs.use_text_format = true # readable .tres instead of binary .res db.backend = fs [/codeblock]

members.member: Application scope folded into the storage path ahead of the save slot. Leave it empty to store slots directly under [member base_dir]. Set it to keep several games sharing one [member base_dir] from colliding.
Root directory for every table subdirectory. Point it at [code]user://saves[/code] for a shipped game: a [code]res://[/code] root is rewritten to [code]user://[/code] outside the editor.
Picks the record file extension. [code]true[/code] writes the readable [code].tres[/code] text form, and [code]false[/code] the compact binary [code].res[/code].
